name: 04281 · South Paris, ME
findings: ZIP 04281 (South Paris) has 14 nonprofit organizations. 5 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 4 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 04281 (South Paris) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
